externalSchedule.schedule: 08:00 start plus 5-minute same-task continuation window through 09:55 Asia/Shanghai
outerAgentProtocol: Every wake first uses the read-only status entrypoint. If the exact business date has no run, create one exact run only inside the continuation window. Otherwise reuse the one run_id returned by the workflow SQLite authority; never create a second run.
Run the public entrypoint for that exact run. Read the final compact stdout summary and the exact run-scoped workflow_handoff.json it names; do not depend on one large stdout payload.

Once the public entrypoint process is running, wait for that live process to exit. Do not infer a hang from artifact or file-mtime silence and do not interrupt a live process on that basis; the existing Douyin bounded tail retry may remain silent for 600000ms. The existing total automation execution boundary remains unchanged.

When the public entrypoint reports waiting_stage or waiting_stage_process, end only this bounded outer turn. The same ai-rebuild heartbeat and fixed task wakes again in five minutes, reuses the exact run, and lets the process lock either report truthful waiting or resume the latest committed checkpoint.

When editorial is required, the current Automation Codex directly applies ai-account-editorial-director to this exact candidate batch and writes the existing simple editorial result file. It decides standalone eligibility, ranking and candidate-specific reasons without seeing scripts, PM/Dev/QA history or release prose. Each reason cites the candidate's own available fact and makes the source-to-thesis bridge explicit: say what concrete source detail changes or puts at stake, why that detail supports the selected angle, and where Austin interpretation or a proposed test begins. Do not leap from a feature/list to a broad conclusion; do not reuse generic batch reasons. Evidence quantity is not recommendation eligibility, research failure never automatically changes select to observe, and title value, persona fit, and exploration stay separate. For Seedance-like evidence, state plainly that the robot action footage is real and not generated by Seedance; its relevance is a proposed way to test whether a changed brief preserves action, character and camera relationships, never an observed test result unless the source actually performed it. The deterministic controller validates and commits the result; it does not author editorial content.

When scripts_required is reached, before the first writer submission the current Automation Codex directly reads the approved core Austin persona, original samples, real edit pairs and approved script modules from the existing allowlist in its transient context. This is voice calibration only; it is not current-topic evidence and raw private text is never persisted. A Python path, byte or hash ledger is not a substitute for that direct read. The current Automation Codex directly applies austin-voice-scriptwriter to one selected rich Topic Card at a time. Runtime exposes exactly one topic packet containing only exact identity, same-run source facts, fact boundaries and the existing substantive editorial judgment. The writer still owns the visible title, hook, structure and body; the judgment is context, not a writing blueprint. Establish the audible main conclusion early, then let each paragraph advance one idea without jumping between source fact, explanation, judgment and close. A small number of memorable lines may arise from the topic's actual thesis, but never from a shared contrast formula or count. This is spoken-logic guidance, not a fixed outline or paragraph contract. For the Seedance topic, keep the real-robot-footage versus Seedance boundary explicit and describe changed-brief preservation as a useful question or proposed test unless the source reports that test. The current Codex writes one simple script or item-local material_or_angle_insufficiency failure, the controller commits it, and only then exposes the next topic. Submit before the next topic is exposed. No full-batch script submission exists; resume starts at the first unfinished topic without regenerating completed topics.
Run the same public entrypoint with the simple stage result files until local terminal completion.

The owner-only publisher client reads its runtime-only config and attempts one terminal snapshot. Publish pending is not a business failure. Later continuation wakes return terminal noop and never repeat completed upstream stages, Skills, or an applied Website POST.
